description: This file defines the Article model class for the OpenCart CMS, handling database interactions related to articles, comments, ratings, and related filters.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Model class for handling CRUD operations on articles, comments, ratings, and related data within the OpenCart CMS.

methods.name: getArticle
methods.description: Retrieves a specific article record by its ID, including related descriptions and store link data.

methods.name: getArticles
methods.description: Fetches a list of articles from the database, supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: editRating
methods.description: Updates the rating value of a specific article.

methods.name: getTotalArticles
methods.description: Returns the total count of articles matching optional filters.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Retrieves the layout ID associated with a specific article for a particular store.

methods.name: addComment
methods.description: Creates a new comment for an article, recording author info, comment text, IP, and status.

methods.name: editCommentRating
methods.description: Updates the rating of a specific article comment.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Fetches a single comment record by its ID.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Retrieves a list of comments for a specific article, with filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalComments
methods.description: Counts the total number of comments for an article, with optional filters.

methods.name: addRating
methods.description: Adds a rating to an article comment by a customer, storing rating value, IP, and timestamp.

methods.name: deleteRating
methods.description: Removes a customer's rating for a specific article comment.

methods.name: getRatings
methods.description: Retrieves rating statistics for an article, optionally filtering by comment ID.
